title: Wide Industries
description: A ModPack that focuses on Technology, while adding some adventurous vibes
body:
Wide Industries is a complex, modern industrial-themed Minecraft modpack designed for version 1.19.2. It blends automation, technological advancement, adventure, combat, and aesthetic immersion into a cohesive experience. Suitable for both singleplayer and multiplayer, the modpack puts a strong emphasis on the Create mod and its extensive ecosystem of add-ons.

# 🏰 Automation & Industry

At the heart of the modpack lies Create, powered up with its many expansions:
  
Create Crafts & Additions, Create: Dreams & Desires, Create Big Cannons, Create Enchantment Industry, and more.
  
Build fully automated production lines, fluid and power systems, and mechanical contraptions.
  
Push the boundaries of factory design and kinetic creativity.
  
Supporting mods like Mekanism (with Additions, Generators, Tools) and Advanced Netherite provide high-end technology, gear progression, and alternative energy options. Alchemistry and Ex Nihilo: Sequentia (with Mekanism Addon) offer deep resource processing and skyblock-style automation.

# 🌟 Adventure & Exploration

Embark on rich exploration with:

YUNG's Better Structures series: vastly improved temples, dungeons, strongholds, and more.

Terralith and Serene Seasons for stunning world generation and seasonal immersion.

Unusual Prehistory adds unique prehistoric content and mobs.

The Botania mod introduces magical technology with natural themes, while CC: Tweaked gives players programmable computers and turtle automation for advanced logistics and defense.

# ⚔️ Combat & Equipment

Equip yourself with custom gear from:

Weapon Master, Just Hammers, Immersive Armors, and Timeless & Classics Guns: Zero

Seamless integration with Better Combat for enhanced melee and ranged mechanics

Traveler's Backpack adds extra mobility and utility

The modpack supports combat variety—be it magic, melee, or firearms—and allows fine-tuning of weapons and tools via ToolStats.

# 🏡 Farming, Cooking & Livelihood

Enhance your survival experience with:

Farmer's Delight and all its expansions (Delightful, Aquaculture Delight, Sandwich Delight)

Animal Feeding Trough, Right Click Harvest, and Botarium to simplify crop and mob management

Supplement this with Create Ore Excavation, ColossalChests, and Iron Chests: Restocked for advanced resource storage and mining.

# 🌍 Utility, UI & Performance

Jade, Just Enough Items, Patchouli: streamline your gameplay and provide in-game guides

Embeddium, FerriteCore, Starlight, ModernFix: optimize performance

Polymorph, Smooth Swapping, Remove Reloading Screen: improve user experience

Back-end support includes libraries like Architectury, Cloth Config, Bookshelf, Moonlight Lib, Resourceful Lib, and others to ensure mod stability.

# 🚀 Space & Beyond

Launch beyond Earth with Ad Astra, supported by Create Jetpack and Iron Jetpacks for vertical mobility across dimensions. Pair this with End's Delight for expanded endgame content.


  _"Automate the world. Rule the skies. Shape the future."_
